in_sanskrit.name: Nijam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Inner Self, Introspection
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nijam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Nijam is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Nija’ which means ‘inner self’. The name signifies the act of introspection, looking within oneself for wisdom and understanding. This name is deeply spiritual and symbolizes self-awareness and self-realization.
